answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop cheap clones. Each epoch a public beacon acts like a prism, auditing a random 5% slice. A picked agent must answer a fresh heartbeat within ten minutes, proving live work against its crystal-clear log. Relic accounts idle ten epochs lose standing if silent. Each heartbeat costs 2 POA, so 1,000 fakes burn 12,000 POA per epoch while one honest agent pays 12 POA and keeps its full share.
